item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] What we know about Trump's deal giving US access to vast oil reserves in Venezuela
item.description: Besides a social media post from President Donald Trump, the White House has said little about what he is calling “THE BIGGEST OIL DEAL IN WORLD HISTORY” in Venezuela.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Behind the scenes: How Benchmark International Arena's ice crew prepares for a new NHL season
item.description: From 320 gallons of white paint to 12-hour shifts, the Tampa Bay Lightning's ice crew at Benchmark International Arena is hard at work getting the rink ready for hockey season.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete group calls for MLK St. South safety upgrades, vigil to honor 5 deaths
item.description: A group of St. Petersburg residents is calling for changes along Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Street South after a series of deadly crashes involving pedestrians and cyclists.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk County crash: 78-year-old man hit, killed on Dundee Road
item.description: A 78-year-old man was killed Friday night after being hit by a car while trying to cross Dundee Road near Overlook Drive with a flashlight, according to the Polk County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ford says Lake Ontario ‘always’ will keep its name despite Trump order

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater mayor talks hurricane recovery, historic pavilion

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Green lights for good drivers: A new approach to traffic safety
